EgyAkin is a comprehensive kidney health: EgyAkin is a comprehensive kidney health management platform dedicated to empowering Egypt's fight against kidney failure. We provide cutting-edge data collection, insightful analytics, and robust community support to help healthcare professionals and patients effectively manage and monitor kidney health.
Our mission is to improve kidney health: Our mission is to improve kidney health outcomes in Egypt by offering a comprehensive platform for managing patient data, calculating key health metrics, and tracking patient progress over time. We strive to provide valuable insights and support to both healthcare providers and patients, fostering a collaborative approach to combating kidney failure.
Add and manage patients with structured: Add and manage patients with structured clinical sections, advanced filters, export options, and role-based access for your practice.
Our program uses the 2021 race-free CKD-: Our program uses the 2021 race-free CKD-EPI equation as the primary eGFR method according to NKF/ASN recommendations, while MDRD and Sobh equations are retained for comparison and research purposes only.
Record serial lab values such as creatin: Record serial lab values such as creatinine with date and time, edit or remove entries, and review reading history within patient sections.
Monitor kidney health over time with lon: Monitor kidney health over time with longitudinal patient data, section updates, and progress across visits.
Share posts and images, join specialty g: Share posts and images, join specialty groups, create polls, explore trending topics, and collaborate with peers across Egypt.
Send and respond to clinical consultatio: Send and respond to clinical consultations between verified doctors, with threaded replies and case follow-up.
Gain valuable insights to improve kidney: Gain valuable insights to improve kidney health outcomes.
Connect with healthcare professionals an: Connect with healthcare professionals and patients through our community platform for knowledge sharing and support.
Get AI-assisted clinical guidance and co: Get AI-assisted clinical guidance and consultation history tailored for nephrology workflows.
Upload clinical forms and documents for: Upload clinical forms and documents for AI-assisted extraction and analysis to support faster documentation.
Chat in real time with colleagues in ded: Chat in real time with colleagues in dedicated rooms, with media sharing for coordinated patient care.
This app is intended for informational p: This app is intended for informational purposes only and should not be used as a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of your physician or another qualified health provider with any questions you may have regarding a medical condition.

• 📊 Repeatable readings: New question type for serial lab values (e.g. creatinine) with date and optional time; add, edit, remove entries, and undo recent saves.
  • 📎 File upload questions: Attach images or documents to patient section answers where your permissions allow.
  • 🧮 eGFR calculator: CKD-EPI 2021 race-free equations with creatinine, cystatin C, or both; biomarker selector and local calculation history.
  • ✅ Multiple choice & Other: Improved "Other" answer field for multi-select questions, including better sync when AI fills answers.
  • 🔐 Permissions & settings: Searchable permissions list in More; refreshed Change Password and Contact Us screens.
